Description: For the duration of this spell, the caster may work nonmagic wood
For the duration of this spell, the caster can make a sheet of paper that will hold one first level spell. Creation takes one week per level of spell that the rune paper can hold
As Work Wood, except cloth may be worked
As Rune Paper I, except paper will hold up to a second level spell
Allows the caster to make a "wand." Note that this spell does not put any spells into the wand; it simply creates the physical object
As Work Wood, except allows caster to work ordinary organic material
As Rune Paper I, except paper will hold up to a third level spell
As Rune Paper I, except paper will hold up to a fifth level spell
As Make Wand, except a "rod" can be made
As Rune Paper I, except paper will hold up to a seventh level spell
As Rune Paper I, except paper will hold up to a tenth level spell
As Make Wand, except a "staff" can be made
As Rune Paper I, except paper will hold up to a thirteenth level spell
As Rune Paper I, except paper will hold up to a sixteenth level spell
As Work Organic, except any organic material can be worked (e.g., this might be required to work the skins of dragons or other "enchanted" creatures)
As Rune Paper I, except paper will hold up to a twentieth level spell
As Work Wood, except magic wood may be worked
As Rune Paper I, except paper will hold any level spell. ORGANIC SKILLS
